reviews.text:
Initially seemed like a nice calm place at 3 am in the morning only to find that the consultation was very weak, the prescription incorrect to the problem and subsequently made my cat worse. It seems as though this is a prelude to being asked to keep returning and paying for more so consultations with no resolution. Eventually got the help my cat needed from a local charitable trust having spent too much wasted time and effort consulting with the staff at The animal hospital in Camberwell. A very disappointing experience unfortunately.

I will add that I had to return in an emergency situation last year summer with another of my cats who was critical and they were the closest surgical team available after hours. Reluctant but desperate I took my cat who was at deaths door. On this occasion the surgeon and post surgical care was excellent and my cats life was saved and the problem resolved with expertise and empathy. The cost was huge but losing my cat would have been a higher cost. I say this to give them their dues, because although my initial experience many years ago now (see above) wasn’t great, this time (June 2025) was very different. I think like with many vets, it depends who you get on shift ok the day!

Review for Medivet Knightsbridge Animal Hospital. Visit on 3/08/2025 at 13:00.

I had a very positive experience at Medivet Knightsbridge with my cat Bonnie. The clinic was clean, welcoming, and well-organised. The staff were friendly and professional, and the vet took great care in examining Bonnie thoroughly. Medication was prescribed, all my questions were answered with patience, and I was given helpful advice for her ongoing care. Thank you to the team for your support and kindness.

I had to take my rabbit twice with GI Stasis and both times it was the weekend and late at night. Both times I was seen Straight away and my bunny being taken care of in such a wonderful way! Thank you! Update..it's now been 3 times and they are still as lovely as ever!! Update it's now been a 4th time with my other rabbit. Got an emergency appointment right away and very lovely!!(They only get sick at weekends!)
My cat Teddy is nerous of the vets, they are so good with him.

I wish I could give zero stars. This practice is an utter shambles with rude vets and useless support staff. I feel livid that I had to go there as it is the nearest 24 hour hospital.

It's a horrible place to go when you are already distraught about your ill pet.

My dog had a heart condition and I got him in he could not breathe air all that was done was medication given. Got him home and one day later it got worse and I rushed him to a normal vet, they did a ultrasound of his heart and x ray of his chest, there was nothing that could be done and he died in my arms Monday afternoon 25 November. My point is that the animal hospital should have known this was very serious. My dog was 13 years old, still got his brother and he is fine.

Kind service with reasonable prices for the procedure my Beagle needed.
Good service. Overall, I liked everything. It was very polite. But the wait was too long; in some cases, minutes can mean too much.
Very helpful and friendly staff, our 9 week young puppy had a very pleasant first time vet experience there
Really good staff and service. The vets are amazing 🤩 …

We went there for our little dog who was severely ill and on his way. Because we knew his time was coming we wanted to take him home for one last night before our appointment the next morning. They threatened us with legalities and unfortunately our little boy passed away alone, at the hospital over night. We hope that whatever we were invoiced was actually administered so that it wasn’t too painful for him but we can’t be sure. The only people I want to thank are the front desk staff who were sympathetic and allowed us to view our little boy multiple times that day
